about: Fallbacks for the home page's case films (Round 05). The pictures themselves (hero sites, film frames, concept stills and previews) are listed in captures.json, made by tools/capture/; home.js reads both and captures.json wins. Paths are relative to the site root.

films.about: What each case film shows when captures.json (tools/capture/films.py) has no frames for it: 'scroll' scrolls the real site's full-page screenshot inside each screen down to endY (pixels in the picture); 'everest-mock' is the mock-up of the design, with the air conditioner opening as the room cools from 32 to 26 °C.

fallback.about: Until frames exist: the real site scrolls inside each screen from its top to endY (pixels in the picture) as the film plays.
Until frames exist: the mock-up of the design, with the air conditioner opening as the room cools from 32 to 26 °C.
